name: Kitagawa Keito
source:
Keito is 18 years old and a freshman at Asakizaka University.
After living in a dormitory for 6 years, he returns to his parents house. 
However his mother, [url=/c85529]Chikage[/url], is too busy with work to talk to him and his younger sister, [url=/c85531]Aki[/url], is in a rebellious phase. 
He really respects his Mother and wish she would show him more love.

Hoping to regain some kind of warm family relationship, he consults with his neighbor, [url=/c85527]Kyouko[/url], who he knows since he was a child.
But this leads to an unbelievably naughty development involving two families.
